mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_quota_allocation WHERE leave_request_id=#{requestId} AND business_round=#{round} ORDER BY bucket_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_quota_event WHERE leave_request_id=#{requestId} AND business_round=#{round} AND BINARY event_key=BINARY #{eventKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_quota_allocation SET status=#{status},update_time=NOW() WHERE allocation_id=#{id} AND status=#{expected}
UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_request SET quota_status=#{status} WHERE leave_request_id=#{requestId} AND business_round=#{round} AND quota_policy_json IS NOT NULL

UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_request SET status='RETURNED',quota_status=CASE WHEN quota_units IS NULL THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' ELSE 'RELEASED' END,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE leave_request_id=#{requestId} AND business_round=#{round} AND status='SUBMITTING' AND approval_instance_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.source_day_result_id day_result_id,t.shop_id,t.source_business_date business_date FROM oa_attendance_overtime_transfer t JOIN oa_attendance_leave_balance_bucket b ON b.bucket_id=t.bucket_id WHERE b.user_id=#{userId} AND b.leave_type_id=#{typeId} AND b.source_type='OVERTIME' AND b.expiry_state!='REVERSED' AND t.action='APPLY' ORDER BY t.source_day_result_id
